name: idle-paws
description: A pixel pet (cat, dog or duck) that hangs out on your Claude window, plus a menu of your favourite web games to play while Claude works.
long_description: Idle Paws adds a pixel pet that walks, sleeps and plays fetch on top of Claude's input bar, and hops when a Claude Code session finishes. Right-click the pet for its menu; double-click to play fetch. With Show games on, the menu's Games button opens your games in the side browser pane, starting with a few picks you can add to or remove. macOS only.

show_games.title: Show games
show_games.description: Add a Games button to the pet's menu, opening a games menu in Claude's side browser pane. It starts with a few games; add your own or remove any from the menu, or ask Claude.

tools.name: open_game
tools.description: Open your games menu in the browser pane

tools.name: add_game
tools.description: Add a game link to your games menu

tools.name: remove_game
tools.description: Remove a game from your games menu
